incoming.name: Aquarium
incoming.excerpt: The nitrogen waste produced in a tank is metabolized in aquaria by a type of bacteria known as nitrifiers (genus Nitrosomonas).

outgoing.name: Russia
outgoing.excerpt: This process was discovered by the Russian microbiologist, Sergei Winogradsky.

outgoing.name: Soil
outgoing.excerpt: Nitrification is an important step in the nitrogen cycle in soil.
